page.overview:
What is Twisted Animatronics?

The Twisted Animatronics are half-organic, half-robotic animatronic-like monsters and counterparts. They appeared in The Twisted Ones as the main antagonists, alongside their creator, William Afton.

The twisted animatronics' design is similar to the nightmare animatronics from the series' main universe but more feral and almost organic-looking. With the Illusion Disc imported, the twisted animatronics has two alternate forms:

Created by Afton Robotics, LLC, the twisted animatronics are designed to lure and kill their victims using Springlock mechanisms. Their Illusion Discs emit high-pitched audio to change the victims' perspective views, making them see the twisted animatronics in a different way depending on their memories. As with the Nightmare Animatronics, the twisted Animatronics seem to have shared personality traits. In this case, they are all subservient purely to their creator, William Afton, but have also exhibited relentlessness when chasing their victims, and ruthlessness when killing them. Although built purely to kill whomsoever Afton tells them to, they have been known to lash out violently whenever provoked.

Twisted Freddy is one of the twisted animatronics and an antagonist in Five Nights at Freddy's: The Twisted Ones. He is the twisted incarnation of Freddy Fazbear, which was created by William Afton to hunt down and kill Charlotte Emily, along with the other twisteds.
